paragraphs: Before each shift, inspect the furnace and instruments. After startup, monitor temperature curves and adjust fuel and charging. Assess conditions before tapping and open valves. Sample after casting, inspect equipment, handle alarms, record processes, and clean the area before handoff.
In short, they turn ore into qualified molten metal. They monitor furnace temperature, control charging, tap metal, tend equipment, record processes, and handle exceptions on the smelting front line.
